{{Quote|GEONOSIS FORWARD CONTROL TO FLEET SUPPORT, ORD MANTELL.''"<br />"''PREPARE TO RECEIVE CASEVAC TRANSPORT. MED TRIAGE TEAM ESTIMATE SERIOUS INJURIES, TWELVE THOUSAND, REPEAT TWELVE THOUSAND. WALKING WOUNDED EIGHT THOUSAND, REPEAT EIGHT THOUSAND. ETA TEN HOURS.|Genonosis Forward Control after the First Battle of Geonosis|<ref name="RC:HC" />}}
'''Fleet Support''' was a structure used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] on<ref name="RC:HC" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] for at least three [[Standard month/Legends|months]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="TERC" /> Fleet Support consisted of [[Fleet Support Base]] and [[Fleet Support Air Station|Air Station]] in addition to its [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]], and was active after the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. In the aftermath of the battle, [[Geonosis Forward Control]] called upon Fleet Support to receive twenty thousand injured [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and an additional seventy-two thousand combat-fit [[Trooper/Legends|troops]], who were delivered via the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] [[Implacable (Acclamator-class)/Legends|''Implacable'']]. A number of these [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were accommodated by Fleet Support Base.<ref name="RC:HC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fleet Support appeared in the [[2004]] novel ''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact|Hard Contact]]'', the first novel in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' series written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="RC:HC" />
